title: Mrs de Massey
html_source: Owner of the hotel, (Gifford & Seidman Ulysses Annotated).

anchor.prefix:
— What is it? loud boots unmannerly asked. 

 — Find out, Miss Douce retorted, leaving her spyingpoint. 

 — Your beau, is it? 

 A haughty bronze replied: 

 — I'll complain to
anchor.suffix:
on you if I hear any more of your impertinent insolence. 

 — Imperthnthn thnthnthn, bootsnout sniffed rudely, as he retreated as she threatened as he had come. 

1922#247

 Bloom
